errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the line for 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' is dashed; the legend and plot show it is a solid line.
The line for 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' starts exactly at 60 on the y-axis, not 62.
The line for 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' ends at a WER of approximately 32, not 35. The value 35 corresponds to the final point of the 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4' line.
The line for 'tiny int4' starts at a WER of approximately 69, not 60. The value 60 is the starting point for two other lines ('tiny AdaLoRA_int8' and 'tiny int8').
The line for 'tiny int4' ends at a WER of approximately 40, not 38. The value 38 is closer to the final point of the 'tiny int8' line.
The line for 'tiny int8' starts exactly at 60 on the y-axis, not 58.
The line for 'tiny full' shows a clear, albeit slight, downward trend from a WER of approximately 29 to 23. Describing it as 'steady' is an inaccurate over-generalization.
The line for 'tiny full' starts at approximately 29 and ends at approximately 23. Using a single value of 'around 28' for both the start and end is incorrect and misleading.
